title: WMBT (What Must Be True) Schema
description: Schema for What Must Be True statements that define measurable outcomes
$comment: This schema is NOT applied as a file-level gate to WMBT files (unlike wagon.schema.json and train.schema.json — there is no jsonschema.validate(wmbt_data, this_schema) anywhere). WMBT correctness is enforced by Python content validators (test_wmbt_vocabulary, test_hierarchy_coverage, test_wmbt_has_smoke_acceptance, test_wmbt_consistency) plus per-acceptance validation against acceptance.schema.json. The `acceptances` property is declared so this schema honestly describes the real WMBT file shape (every plan/ WMBT carries acceptances); `additionalProperties: false` is retained as-is but is never enforced against files. See #760.

urn.description: WMBT URN: wmbt:{wagon}:{step_coded_id} (e.g., wmbt:burn-timebank:E001) - step-coded sequence

step.description: JTBD decomposition step indicating where in the job flow this outcome matters

direction.description: Optimization direction indicating how to improve the outcome

dimension.description: Measurement dimension - exactly one per WMBT to maintain focus

object_of_control.description: Descriptive of what is being controlled or measured

context_clarifier.description: Detailed situational phrase specifying when/where/how this applies (one line maximum)

lens.description: Specific lens aspect reference (e.g., functional.efficiency, emotional.trust, social.belong)

statement.description: Human-readable statement: direction + dimension + object_of_control + context_clarifier

acceptances.description: Embedded acceptances for this WMBT. WMBT files are NOT file-validated against this schema (see top-level $comment); embedded acceptances use a lighter shape than the standalone acceptance.schema.json — identity/harness/given/when/then with `abstract` fields plus metadata.author/created, and no top-level `signal`. Described here for honesty; see acceptance.schema.json definitions.embedded_acceptance.

appendices.description: Supplementary files specific to this WMBT scenario
